style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), bright warm light, rich detail, cinematic depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third and the middle fairly simple (text sits there). Ancient Mesopotamia, the time of the great flood.

scenes.s1: A colossal wooden ark standing alone on dry empty land under a darkening sky, first heavy drops of rain, dramatic clouds, a little golden light breaking through. Absolutely no people anywhere.
scenes.s2: Ordinary villagers in rough ancient robes turning away and laughing, some covering their ears, walking away from a hillside at dusk, seen from the side and behind.
scenes.s3: A lone oil lamp glowing on a rocky hilltop at night under a vast sky full of stars, hopeful, no person visible.
scenes.s4: A huge wooden ark half built on a plain, timber and ropes, while a group of arrogant rich chiefs in fine robes stand in the foreground mocking and pointing at it, seen from behind and the side. No builder figure in focus.
scenes.s5: The giant ark riding enormous waves as tall as mountains in a storm, rain pouring, dramatic but bright lightning glow. The deck is empty, absolutely no people visible anywhere.
scenes.s6: The ark resting high on a green mountain top after the flood, clouds parting, golden sunlight, calm water below, birds flying, peaceful and bright. Absolutely no people anywhere.
